steps.instruction: Spray a 12-inch pizza pan with cooking spray.
Sprinkle the pan lightly with corn meal, if you like.
Starting in the center, press the pizza crust dough an inch past the sides of the pan.
Fold the hanging edge toward the middle, tucking in 7 pieces of string cheese.
steps.spoken: Fold the hanging edge of the dough back toward the middle, placing the 7 one-inch pieces of string cheese in the pouch, all the way around the circle.

steps.instruction: Pinch the dough to seal in the cheese.

steps.spoken: Bake the crust for 8 to 10 minutes, until the edges are light golden and the dough has started to set.

steps.instruction: Take the crust out of the oven.
Spread 1/2 cup of pizza sauce over the crust with the back of a spoon.
Scatter 24 slices of pepperoni, 1 cup of sausage and 2 cups of Italian cheese on top.
steps.spoken: Scatter 24 slices of pepperoni, 1 cup of cooked, crumbled Italian sausage and 2 cups of shredded Italian blend cheese over the sauce.

steps.instruction: Put it back in the oven until the crust is deeply golden and the cheese melts.
